summary: Speed indicator for unknown-total tasks is implemented. Changes: (1) TaskProgressColumn in rich/progress.py gains a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed(speed) that scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix (base 1000, suffixes "", ×10³, ×10⁶, ×10⁹, ×10¹²) and returns Text styled "progress.percentage", and a render() branch that shows speed when the total is None and show_speed is on, using task.finished_speed or task.speed. The class docstring documents all constructor args. (2) Module-level track() gains show_speed: bool = True as the last parameter, passed to TaskProgressColumn. (3) Progress.track declares task_total: Optional[float] up front and no longer raises for non-Sized iterables without a total. (4) CHANGELOG.md has the new Unreleased/Added line. (5) tests/test_progress.py drops the two ValueError assertions and adds test_task_progress_column_speed. Not verified: tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions. No commits were made.
